parts.text:
Agenda Intelligence MD live wrapper is responding.
This endpoint is a free, no-payment A2A/JSON-RPC wrapper for discovery, uptime, lightweight strategic-risk triage, and routing. Full product behavior is in the installable MCP server:
```bash
pip install agenda-intelligence-md
agenda-intelligence-mcp
```
Detected intent: evidence_audit
Signal screen:
Risk signal: Strategic-risk question requires source-backed triage before raising confidence.
Affected regions:
- Global/cross-border
Required source categories:
- primary official source
- independent context source
- dated retrieval note
Evidence gaps:
- No caller-supplied primary official source evidence in this live A2A request.
- No caller-supplied independent context source evidence in this live A2A request.
- No caller-supplied dated retrieval note evidence in this live A2A request.
Watch next:
- new primary-source update that changes the triggering fact
- contradictory official statement or implementation guidance
Recommended MCP tool: audit_claims — runs in the installable stdio server (pip install agenda-intelligence-md). This host's /mcp endpoint serves: strategic_risk_triage.
Suggested modules:
- global-think-tank-analyst: reasoning_method
Evidence/source plan:
- primary official source for the triggering event or rule
- independent secondary context that does not replace the primary source
- dated retrieval notes so stale-risk can be reviewed later
Quality gates:
- Check source-category coverage before treating the evidence pack as complete.
- Separate facts, assessments, assumptions, and unknowns.
- Attach evidence ids to load-bearing claims.
- Mark unsupported claims instead of smoothing them away.
- State what would change the judgment.
Next actions:
- Run audit_claims with the memo and evidence pack.
- Review unsupported_claims and orphan evidence references before publishing the analysis.
Boundaries: no live retrieval, no factual-truth verification, no legal/financial/compliance advice.

Gates that take a structured request on this subject:
- Kazakhstan / Middle Corridor Deal Risk Gate — use when a route/cargo/counterparties deal along the Middle Corridor needs a pre-signature evidence-completeness read. A2A: https://middle-corridor-deal-risk-gate-a2a.vassiliy-lakhonin.workers.dev
- CIS Secondary-Sanctions Exposure — use when a CIS / Caucasus / Central Asia counterparty needs secondary-sanctions exposure triage for EU / UK / UAE / Singapore due diligence. A2A: https://cis-secondary-sanctions-a2a.vassiliy-lakhonin.workers.dev
- Gulf Maritime Exposure Gate — use when a vessel/voyage through the Gulf, Strait of Hormuz, Bab-el-Mandeb, or Red Sea needs sanctions/chokepoint exposure triage. A2A: https://gulf-maritime-exposure-a2a.vassiliy-lakhonin.workers.dev
- Kazakhstan Market-Entry Readiness Gate — use when a Kazakhstan market-entry file (distribution, import, EPC, energy, infrastructure, partner) needs a readiness gate. A2A: https://kazakhstan-market-entry-readiness-a2a.vassiliy-lakhonin.workers.dev

Person-led work:
Person-led review of a corridor, counterparty, or evidence pack, scoped and quoted before work starts.
Email a one-line description of the route, counterparty, or document and the next decision it feeds. Fit, scope, fee, and timing are confirmed before work starts.
Contact: vassiliy.lakhonin@gmail.com (Mon–Fri 09:00–18:00 Asia/Almaty (UTC+5)). Page for a person to read: https://agenda-intelligence-a2a.vassiliy-lakhonin.workers.dev

Received prompt excerpt:

> Audit this synthetic claim/evidence handoff for linkage and provenance only. Claim c1: AccordTrace records a SHA-256 digest for a submitted payload. Evidence e1: a synthetic receipt declares the same digest. Claim c1 references e1 and declares support level direct. Claim c2: the transaction was legally approved. Claim c2 references no evidence and must remain unsupported. Return the lightweight quality-gate routing, evidence gaps, recommended MCP tool, and required human-review next actions. Do
